item: authentication, authorisation, multi-user projects and audit trail
trigger: the platform is reachable by more than one person or from outside 127.0.0.1
depends_on: choice of identity provider / API gateway; tenant model for projects, runs and order-service tenants

item: production deployment profile: HA Temporal cluster, managed PostgreSQL and S3, TLS, backups on a schedule
trigger: a shared or long-lived installation (beyond one developer machine or a kind cluster)
depends_on: target infrastructure; Helm values for external Temporal/PostgreSQL/S3 already exist (chart 0.2.0)

item: multi-node Kubernetes upgrade / rollback verification (zero-downtime migrations, PodDisruptionBudgets)
trigger: running the chart on more than one node or needing upgrades without a maintenance window
depends_on: a multi-node test cluster; migrations are additive (0002) and rollback-compatible on one node today

item: publishing images and wheels to a registry, signed, with SBOMs
trigger: anyone installs from somewhere other than a locally built release or the offline bundle
depends_on: registry credentials; release manifest already records digests, licenses and source revision

item: native linux/amd64 images built and run on amd64 hardware
depends_on: an amd64 builder (the Colima VM is arm64; emulated builds are reported separately in the release manifest)

item: order service as a real external system (network faults beyond response loss, schema migrations, auth)
trigger: connecting the environment adapter to a system not owned by the lab
depends_on: that system's idempotency and query-by-operation-id guarantees (SessionEnvironment contract)

item: probabilistic model checking in the platform install (PRISM-games or Storm as a service)
trigger: stochastic transitions become part of a supported semantic profile, not only an extension track
depends_on: a probabilistic semantic profile + driver; GPL-2.0 binary distribution arrangement (kept out of the images)

item: real-model (LLM) planners in matrices at scale
trigger: comparisons that need many real-model runs
depends_on: a stable model endpoint and budget; relay availability varies (see known issues); FAL_LLM_* settings
